data.name: Portals Edge
data.detailed_description:
• Game Overview

A medieval/modern open world game where you and a team are trying to track down and defeat the creator of the outbreak to open the portal back to the real world. You go on missions either by yourself, or with a teammate or two to gather information about the creator (kind of like the bo5 campaign.) and sometimes you have to use portals to travel between the medieval and modern universes for these missions. That's a rundown of the base story line. Some other cool things we'll have is the ability to go on side missions with people and build relationships, you can build unique, unbuyable weapons that range in rarity and all their own unique way of killing things, and some other cool mechanics.

  • Your horse is your lifeline.

    Not a feature. Not a gimmick. A necessity.

    • Escape massive open-world hordes
    • Carry weapons, gear, and crafting supplies
    • Upgrade speed, stamina, armor, and storage
    • Heal it. Protect it. Depend on it.

    When everything goes wrong — and it will — your horse is the difference between survival and death.

  • CINDERVALE
    Rotting villages. Collapsing castles. Plague swamps. Horde-filled dungeons.
    Darkness isn’t atmosphere — it’s a threat.

  • THE MODERN WASTELAND
    Overgrown cities. Military quarantine zones. Abandoned suburbs. Industrial graveyards.
    Civilization didn’t fall quietly.

Travel between timelines through portals as both worlds begin to merge — and break.

Each universe brings unique enemies, combat styles, traversal challenges, and environmental dangers.

  • This is survival combat at full intensity.

    • Precision firearm gameplay with limited ammo
    • Vicious melee combat with degradable, upgradable weapons
    • Real-time crafting mid-fight
    • Stealth systems built on sound, visibility, and positioning
    • Intelligent enemies that flank, track, communicate, and hunt

    Fight human factions. Face evolving infected variants.
    Survive overwhelming hordes.
    Endure multi-phase boss encounters that test everything you’ve learned.

    No hand-holding. No mercy.

  • Scavenge. Craft. Adapt.

    • Create rare, secret buildable weapons with unique abilities
    • Set traps. Craft explosives. Modify melee weapons
    • Upgrade skill trees across stealth, survival, and combat
    • Manage scarce resources under constant pressure
    • Strengthen your horse to survive longer journeys

    Every bullet matters.
    Every decision costs something.

  • Rise within your community.

    Build relationships. Go on side missions. Earn loyalty.
    But as trust grows, so does deception.

    Dr. Langford — the mind behind the outbreak — isn’t just an enemy.

    He’s waiting.

    As reality collapses and the medieval and modern worlds bleed into one another, the truth behind the infection will challenge everything you believe.

    Nothing is as it seems.

data.short_description: Action-Adventure Game where you and your team go on missions to defeat the creator of the outbreak and open the portal back to the real world, except multiple universes are against you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 580 or Nvidia Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon 6600 XT or Nvidia Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
